propositions: ADR 0035 section 6 falsely asserts the first real second backend is out of scope across three locations (diagram comment, prose, decision item, consequences), but epic e369 landed Jira Data Center first, before the GitHub adapter be74

The reconciler calls 21 distinct transport members but TicketTransport declares only 6; 12 missing members caused a live crash (set_entity_property) while isinstance, contract suite, and 1636 unit tests all passed green
RemoteRef.instance is documented as a provenance design to distinguish deployments but is never constructed in production code, creating a gap between intended and actual design

The jira_family layer introduces a two-level seam between core and concrete adapter with parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) and shared jira creation channel, deferring generalization to epic be74
Jira Data Center receives no new features after March 2029 read-only transition, making the durable asset the family seam architecture rather than the DC adapter itself
Contract-suite certification of backends is conditional on the port being complete and typed; unannotated transport parameters make port incompleteness invisible to mypy and static analysis
